text: @ryantzhou/dsh-codex 是面向 DSH Web 的 Codex 风格 agent 预设与工具扩展。它把预设加入 DSH，并提供补丁编辑、shell 命令与交互终端会话、计划更新、向用户提问和查看本地图片等工具；同时调整工具调用的会话展示，并为 apply_patch 接入语法约束。适合希望在 DSH 中使用 Codex 风格编程工作流的用户。运行需 DSH Web 及兼容的运行时组件；语法约束能力取决于模型路由支持。

@ryantzhou/dsh-codex brings a Codex-style agent preset to DSH Web, with patch edits, shell and interactive terminal sessions, plan updates, user questions, and local image viewing. It adds grammar-constrained apply_patch and Codex-style tool displays. Requires compatible DSH runtime components.
我想让 DSH 用 Codex 风格的工具来改代码和跑命令。
能不能在 DSH 里给 GPT agent 一个交互式终端？
让 DSH agent 按 Codex 的补丁格式编辑项目文件。
我希望 agent 能整理任务步骤，也能在需要时向我确认选项。
I want my DSH coding agent to edit files with patches and keep long-running terminal sessions available.
Can I use a Codex-like preset in DSH that can update plans and ask me questions?
@ryantzhou/dsh-codex 的功能「补丁编辑」：agent 调用 apply_patch 提交文件补丁，工具将其转交给 DSH shell 执行，并在对话中展示解析出的文件改动。
@ryantzhou/dsh-codex 的功能「统一命令会话」：agent 通过 exec_command 运行 shell 命令，可选择交互式终端；命令仍运行时返回会话编号，再用 write_stdin 输入内容或读取后续输出。
@ryantzhou/dsh-codex 的功能「计划与用户交互」：agent 可用 update_plan 更新步骤状态，也可通过 request_user_input 展示选择题并等待用户回答。

@ryantzhou/dsh-codex README · Why：GPT-5.6 does not perform as well in DSH's default Standard mode because its post-training expects the prompts, tools, schemas, and result formats used by Codex. Recreating those conventions gives GPT models a familiar environment where their coding behavior feels more at home, while preserving DSH's native experience for DeepSeek models. This makes it practical to use DeepSeek and GPT models side by side in the same DSH installation without forcing either through an unfamiliar agent setup.

@ryantzhou/dsh-codex README · Compatibility：Version 0.2.0 targets DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 and pi-ai 0.82.1. The extension uses small runtime bridges because those DSH versions do not expose grammar metadata or package-provided preset roots as public extension seams. Dependencies are pinned so an incompatible DSH upgrade fails installation instead of silently changing behavior.

@ryantzhou/dsh-codex README · Compatibility：Grammar custom tools require a GPT-5+ pi-ai route whose model metadata enables `supportsOpenAIGrammarTools`, such as the built-in OpenAI, OpenAI Codex, Azure OpenAI Responses, GitHub Copilot, opencode, or Cloudflare AI Gateway routes. Unsupported routes receive pi-ai's normal function-tool fallback.

@ryantzhou/dsh-codex README · Install：Install the bundle into every DSH profile where the preset should be available:

~~~sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @ryantzhou/dsh-codex
~~~

After the command completes, restart that DSH process and select **Codex-style mode** when creating a session.

Remove it with the matching package spec:

~~~sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @ryantzhou/dsh-codex
~~~

@ryantzhou/dsh-codex README · How it works：The Codex tools themselves delegate to DSH's existing `bash`/`pwsh`, `todo_write`, `ask_user_question`, and `read_image` tools. This keeps policy enforcement and UI behavior in their existing owners. `apply_patch` runs the bundled parser and applicator through the same sandboxed shell delegate.

@ryantzhou/dsh-codex README · Development：~~~sh
corepack pnpm install
corepack pnpm check
corepack pnpm test
corepack pnpm build
corepack pnpm pack
~~~
